attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.facility. Business justification: Hospital outpatient pharmacies and specialty pharmacies embedded in facilities must be linked to provider.facility for network credentialing, directory accuracy, and network adequacy reporting. Regula

attributes.name: ncpdp_provider_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Provider ID
attributes.description: The 7-digit NCPDP pharmacy identifier (formerly NABP number) used as the primary pharmacy identifier in PBM claim transactions, formulary lookups, and pharmacy network directories. Sourced from RxClaim or Argus PBM system.
attributes.references: NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; CMS Part D; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

tag_set.value: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Provider ID

attributes.name: network_service_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.service_area. Business justification: CMS Part D and state Medicaid regulations require pharmacy network adequacy assessment by service area. Linking dispensing pharmacies to service areas enables geographic access reporting, regulatory f

attributes.name: par_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.par_agreement. Business justification: Dispensing pharmacies have formal participation agreements governing network inclusion terms, credentialing, and reimbursement. The PAR agreement is the authoritative record of a pharmacy's network pa

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_method. Business justification: Dispensing pharmacies must have a registered payment method (EFT/ACH bank account) for network reimbursement disbursements. Health insurance pharmacy network operations require payment method registra

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.program. Business justification: Specialty pharmacies are designated as preferred or exclusive dispensers for specific care management programs (e.g., oncology specialty pharmacy, transplant program, hemophilia program). This link en

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.provider_network. Business justification: Required for network participation reporting and CMS network adequacy; each pharmacy must be linked to the provider network it belongs to.

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.tier. Business justification: Pharmacy network tiering drives member cost-sharing — preferred vs. standard vs. specialty pharmacy tiers determine copay differentials. Benefit design and EOB generation require knowing which network

attributes.name: accepts_electronic_prescriptions
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy is enabled to receive electronic prescriptions (e-prescribing) via NCPDP SCRIPT standard. Required for controlled substance e-prescribing (EPCS) compliance in many states.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; DEA EPCS Regulations 21 CFR Part 1311; State E-Prescribing Mandates

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for member pharmacy locator, network directory, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address information (suite, unit, floor) for the pharmacy dispensing location.

attributes.name: awp_discount_percent
attributes.description: The contracted discount percentage applied to the AWP for brand drug ingredient cost reimbursement. For example, AWP minus 15% means awp_discount_percent = 15.00. Applies when ingredient_cost_basis is 'awp_discount'. Commercially sensitive contract term.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Reimbursement Standards; AWP Industry Benchmark; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: chain_independent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy is part of a chain organization (e.g., CVS, Walgreens, Rite Aid) or operates as an independent pharmacy. Affects contract terms, reimbursement rates, and network tier assignment.
attributes.references: NCPDP Pharmacy Chain/Independent Classification; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: chain_organization_name
attributes.description: Name of the parent chain organization if the pharmacy is a chain location (e.g., CVS Health, Walgreens Boots Alliance). Null for independent pharmacies. Used for chain-level contract management and performance reporting.
attributes.references: NCPDP Chain Code Standard; PBM Contract Management

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for geographic network analysis, member access reporting, and CMS Part D network adequacy compliance.
attributes.references: NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; CMS Part D Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: cold_chain_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy holds cold chain certification for temperature-sensitive drug storage and shipping (e.g., biologics, insulin, vaccines). Required for specialty and mail-order pharmacies dispensing refrigerated or frozen medications.
attributes.references: USP Chapter 1118; URAC Specialty Pharmacy Accreditation; CMS Part D Specialty Drug Standards

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy's network participation contract becomes effective. Used to validate claim eligibility by service date and for contract lifecycle management.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Contract Requirements; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: contract_termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy's network participation contract ends or was terminated. Null for active open-ended contracts. Used for claim eligibility validation and network adequacy gap analysis.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Contract Requirements; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy reimbursement contract is negotiated directly with the health plan (direct) or administered through the PBM intermediary (PBM-administered). Affects financial settlement, audit rights, and MAC list applicability.
attributes.references: PBM Contract Standards; ERISA; CMS Part D Pharmacy Contract Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the dispensing pharmacy record was first created in the PBM network master. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record retention requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Part D Record Retention Requirements; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_amount
attributes.description: The contracted per-prescription dispensing fee paid to the pharmacy in addition to ingredient cost reimbursement. Expressed in USD. May vary by pharmacy type, drug type, or days supply. Commercially sensitive contract term.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Dispensing Fee Standards; PBM Contract Standards; NCPDP Claim Adjudication

attributes.name: dispensing_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state code of the state in which the pharmacy is licensed to dispense. May differ from the physical address state for mail-order pharmacies licensed in multiple states. Used for state-level regulatory compliance and claim adjudication.
attributes.references: State Board of Pharmacy Regulations; NABP; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: Trade name or DBA name under which the pharmacy operates if different from the legal business name. Used in member-facing directories and communications.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for prior authorization transmissions, prescription transfers, and clinical communications.
attributes.references: NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: ingredient_cost_basis
attributes.description: The pricing benchmark used to calculate ingredient cost reimbursement for drug claims. AWP (Average Wholesale Price) discount is most common for brand drugs; MAC (Maximum Allowable Cost) applies to generics; WAC (Wholesale Acquisition Cost) and NADAC (National Average Drug Acquisition Cost) are alternative benchmarks. Sourced from PBM contract terms in RxClaim/Argus.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Reimbursement Standards; NCPDP Claim Adjudication; MAC/AWP/WAC Industry Standards

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The health insurance line of business for which this pharmacy network participation record applies. A pharmacy may have separate network records per LOB with different contract terms. Drives claim adjudication routing and formulary selection.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; Medicaid Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; ACA Exchange Requirements

attributes.name: mail_order_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy is certified and operationally capable of fulfilling mail-order prescriptions (90-day supply, home delivery). Drives claim routing and member benefit design enforcement.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Mail Order Pharmacy Requirements; URAC Mail Service Pharmacy Accreditation

attributes.name: ncpdp_chain_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Chain Code
attributes.description: NCPDP-assigned 4-digit chain code identifying the pharmacy chain organization. Used for chain-level contract application and bulk reimbursement rate assignment in the PBM system.

tag_set.value: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Chain Code

attributes.name: network_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy's current network participation status became effective. Distinct from contract_effective_date; captures the most recent network status change date (e.g., reactivation after suspension).
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Requirements; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: network_participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the pharmacy's participation in the PBM network. Drives real-time claim adjudication eligibility checks in RxClaim/Argus. Active pharmacies are eligible to dispense covered drugs; inactive/terminated pharmacies are rejected at point-of-sale.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Requirements; NCQA Pharmacy Accreditation; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: network_termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy's network participation was or is scheduled to be terminated. Null for currently active network participants. Used for claim eligibility validation and network adequacy gap analysis.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Requirements; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: performance_audit_provision
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy contract includes audit provisions allowing the PBM or health plan to conduct on-site or desk audits of dispensing records, pricing, and compliance. Required for CMS Part D sponsor oversight obligations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Audit Requirements 42 CFR Part 423; PBM Contract Standards; ERISA

attributes.name: pharmacy_name
attributes.description: Legal business name of the dispensing pharmacy as registered with the state board of pharmacy and NCPDP. Used in member-facing communications, EOB documents, and provider directory.
attributes.references: NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; State Board of Pharmacy

attributes.name: pharmacy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pharmacy by dispensing channel and operational model. Drives claim routing, reimbursement logic, and formulary applicability within the PBM system (RxClaim/Argus). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: retail|mail_order|specialty|long_term_care|compounding — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: NCPDP Pharmacy Type Codes; CMS Part D Pharmacy Type Classification; PBM Industry Standard

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for member contact, prior authorization coordination, and provider directory.

attributes.name: signature_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy requires patient or authorized representative signature upon delivery for mail-order or specialty drug shipments. Relevant for controlled substances and high-value specialty medications.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; CMS Part D Delivery Requirements; NCPDP Claim Adjudication

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which this pharmacy record was ingested (e.g., RxClaim, Argus PBM, Cactus credentialing system). Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Databricks lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: specialty_accreditation_code
attributes.description: Accreditation body certification held by the pharmacy for specialty drug dispensing. URAC, ACHC, and NABP PCAB are the primary specialty pharmacy accreditation bodies recognized by health plans and PBMs. Required for specialty network participation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: urac|achc|jcaho|nabp_pcab|none — promote to reference product if multi-accreditation tracking is needed]
attributes.references: URAC Specialty Pharmacy Accreditation Standards; ACHC Specialty Pharmacy Standards; NABP PCAB; CMS Part D Specialty Pharmacy Requirements

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for state-level licensure validation, network adequacy reporting, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standard; NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: twenty_four_hour_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy operates 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. Used for network adequacy reporting and member access analysis, particularly for CMS Part D access requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Network Adequacy Standards; State DOI Network Adequacy Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the dispensing pharmacy record was most recently updated. Used for change data capture, data quality monitoring, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Part D Record Retention Requirements; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for geographic network adequacy analysis, member proximity calculations, and CMS Part D access reporting.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standard; CMS Part D Network Adequacy; NCPDP Provider Identification Standard

products.name: pbm_contract
products.description: Master record for PBM (Pharmacy Benefit Manager) contracts governing the relationship between the health plan and the PBM (e.g., RxClaim, Argus). Captures contract name, PBM vendor, contract type (ASO/full-risk/carve-out), effective date range, rebate guarantee terms, dispensing fee schedules, MAC list reference, performance guarantees, audit rights, and LOB scope. This is the SSOT for PBM contractual terms within the pharmacy domain.

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the PBM contract record in the pharmacy domain silver layer. Primary key for this entity. Role: MASTER_AGREEMENT.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account. Business justification: PBM contracts are financially administered through a billing account for rebate settlements, administrative fee payments, and performance guarantee true-ups. Every PBM contract in health insurance ope

attributes.name: broker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to employer.broker. Business justification: Brokers negotiate PBM contracts on behalf of employer groups. Required for commission tracking, contract ownership attribution, and broker performance reporting in group sales operations.

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the drug formulary associated with this PBM contract. The formulary defines covered drugs, tier assignments, and utilization management rules governed by this contract.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements; 42 CFR Part 423; NCQA

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment or addendum executed against this PBM contract. Null if no amendments have been made since original execution. Used to track contract evolution and ensure current terms are applied in adjudication.
attributes.references: ERISA; NAIC; Internal Contract Management Policy

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Contractually specified frequency at which the health plan may exercise audit rights over the PBM. Relevant only when audit_rights_flag is True. Drives compliance calendar and vendor oversight scheduling.
attributes.references: ERISA; CMS Part D; NAIC; State DOI Audit Requirements

attributes.name: audit_rights_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the health plan has contractual audit rights to inspect PBM financial records, rebate calculations, MAC list pricing, and claims adjudication data. True = audit rights granted; False = not included. Critical for compliance and financial oversight.
attributes.references: ERISA; HIPAA; CMS Part D; NAIC; State DOI Audit Requirements

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PBM contract automatically renews at the end of the contract term unless notice of termination is provided. True = auto-renews; False = requires affirmative renewal action.

attributes.name: awp_discount_mail_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Mail Order Percentage
attributes.description: Contracted discount percentage off AWP (Average Wholesale Price) applied to drug ingredient cost reimbursement at mail-order pharmacies. Typically deeper than retail AWP discounts due to mail-order volume.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC; AWP Industry Pricing Standards

tag_set.value: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Mail Order Percentage

attributes.name: awp_discount_retail_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Retail Percentage
attributes.description: Contracted discount percentage off AWP (Average Wholesale Price) applied to brand and generic drug ingredient cost reimbursement at retail pharmacies. A core financial term in PBM contracts (e.g., AWP minus 18% for generics).
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC; AWP Industry Pricing Standards

tag_set.value: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Retail Percentage

attributes.name: cms_contract_number
attributes.description: CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) contract number associated with the Medicare Part D plan under which this PBM contract operates (e.g., H1234 for MA-PD, S1234 for PDP). Required for CMS Part D reporting and RAPS/EDPS submissions. Null for non-Medicare LOBs.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; 42 CFR Part 423; CMS HPMS

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the PBM contract (e.g., 'Express Scripts ASO Agreement FY2024'). Used for display in reporting dashboards and contract management workflows.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable contract reference number assigned by the health plan or PBM vendor at execution. Used for correspondence, audits, and regulatory filings. Maps to the contract identifier in RxClaim or Argus PBM system.
attributes.references: ERISA; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: contract_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the health plan employee or department responsible for managing this PBM contract relationship. Used for escalation routing, audit coordination, and vendor governance.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the PBM contract. Draft indicates the contract is under negotiation; active indicates it is in force; suspended indicates temporarily halted; terminated indicates early cancellation; expired indicates natural end-of-term; pending_renewal indicates renewal is in progress.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Internal Contract Lifecycle Policy

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the PBM contract arrangement. ASO (Administrative Services Only) means the health plan retains financial risk; full_risk means the PBM assumes drug spend risk; carve_out means pharmacy benefits are separated from medical; pass_through means drug costs are passed at actual cost; hybrid combines elements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ASO|full_risk|carve_out|pass_through|hybrid — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: ERISA; CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual; NAIC

attributes.name: contract_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the PBM contract document, incremented with each amendment or renewal (e.g., '1.0', '2.1', 'Amendment_3'). Supports contract lifecycle management and audit trail for regulatory examinations.
attributes.references: ERISA; NAIC; Internal Contract Management Policy

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_mail_order
attributes.description: Contracted dispensing fee in USD paid per prescription claim fulfilled through mail-order pharmacy channels under this PBM contract. Typically lower than retail due to volume efficiencies.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC; Internal PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_retail
attributes.description: Contracted dispensing fee in USD paid to retail network pharmacies per prescription claim under this PBM contract. Part of the pharmacy reimbursement formula alongside ingredient cost (AWP/WAC/MAC).
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC; Internal PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_specialty
attributes.description: Contracted dispensing fee in USD paid per specialty drug prescription claim under this PBM contract. Specialty pharmacy dispensing fees are negotiated separately due to the high-cost, high-touch nature of specialty drugs.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC; Internal PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: dur_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Drug Utilization Review (DUR) — including prospective, concurrent, and retrospective DUR — is included as a service under this PBM contract. True = DUR services included; False = not included.
attributes.references: OBRA 1990; CMS Part D; NCQA; URAC

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the PBM contract becomes legally binding and operationally active. Governs when PBM services, pricing schedules, and rebate guarantees take effect. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: ERISA; CMS Part D; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: generic_dispensing_rate_guarantee
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed minimum generic dispensing rate (GDR) as a percentage of total prescription claims. If the PBM fails to achieve this rate, financial penalties or credits apply. Key cost-management metric in PBM contracts.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA HEDIS; Internal PBM Performance Standards

attributes.name: governing_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the state whose laws govern this PBM contract for dispute resolution and regulatory compliance purposes. Relevant for state DOI oversight, MAC transparency laws, and PBM regulation.
attributes.references: NAIC; State DOI Regulations; State PBM Transparency Laws

attributes.name: ingredient_cost_basis
attributes.description: The drug pricing benchmark used as the basis for ingredient cost reimbursement under this contract. AWP (Average Wholesale Price), WAC (Wholesale Acquisition Cost), MAC (Maximum Allowable Cost), NADAC (National Average Drug Acquisition Cost), or AAC (Actual Acquisition Cost). Determines the reimbursement formula for drug ingredient costs.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC; AWP/WAC Industry Standards; 42 CFR Part 423

attributes.name: lob_scope
attributes.description: Line of Business (LOB) covered under this PBM contract. Determines which member populations and benefit programs are governed by this agreement. A single contract may cover one or multiple LOBs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|medicare_part_d|medicaid|exchange|all — promote to reference product for multi-LOB support]
attributes.references: CMS Part D; ACA; NAIC; 42 CFR Part 423

attributes.name: mac_list_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the MAC (Maximum Allowable Cost) list applied under this PBM contract for generic and multi-source drug reimbursement. MAC lists cap reimbursement for generics below AWP. References the specific MAC list version maintained by the PBM.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC MAC Transparency Laws; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: mail_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether mail-order pharmacy dispensing services are included in the scope of this PBM contract. True = mail order included; False = retail-only or carved out.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; Internal PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: mail_order_penetration_guarantee
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mail Order Penetration Rate Guarantee Percentage
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed minimum mail-order pharmacy utilization rate as a percentage of eligible maintenance drug claims. Drives cost savings through mail-order channel incentives.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; Internal PBM Performance Standards

tag_set.value: Mail Order Penetration Rate Guarantee Percentage

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PBM contract includes financial performance guarantees (e.g., generic dispensing rate, mail-order penetration, member satisfaction scores). True = performance guarantees included; False = not included.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; URAC; Internal PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: prior_auth_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization (PA) requirements for specialty and non-formulary drugs are administered by the PBM under this contract. True = PBM manages PA; False = health plan manages PA internally.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; URAC; 42 CFR Part 423

attributes.name: quantity_limit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether quantity limit (QL) utilization management rules are in scope under this PBM contract. Quantity limits restrict the amount of a drug dispensed per fill or per time period. True = quantity limits apply; False = not applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; URAC; Internal UM Policy

attributes.name: rebate_guarantee_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Guarantee Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed minimum rebate amount expressed as Per Member Per Month (PMPM) in USD that the PBM must remit to the health plan. A key financial performance guarantee in PBM contracts. Used for actuarial reserving and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual; ERISA; GAAP; SAP

tag_set.value: Rebate Guarantee Per Member Per Month (PMPM)

attributes.name: rebate_pass_through_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of manufacturer drug rebates that the PBM is contractually obligated to pass through to the health plan (e.g., 100% pass-through vs. spread-based retention). Critical for MLR (Medical Loss Ratio) calculations and CMS Part D compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; ACA MLR Regulations 45 CFR Part 158; ERISA

attributes.name: rebate_reconciliation_lag_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days after the close of a settlement period within which the PBM must provide rebate invoices and supporting data to the health plan. Used for financial close scheduling and IBNR reserve calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; GAAP; SAP; Internal Finance Policy

attributes.name: rebate_settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Contractually specified frequency at which the PBM remits drug manufacturer rebates to the health plan. Drives cash flow forecasting, accounts receivable management, and actuarial IBNR (Incurred But Not Reported) rebate estimates.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; GAAP; SAP; Internal Finance Policy

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PBM contract record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with HIPAA record retention requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; NAIC; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PBM contract record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change detection, SCD (Slowly Changing Dimension) processing, and audit trail requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; NAIC; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days prior to contract termination_date by which either party must provide written notice of intent not to renew. Operationally critical for contract management and vendor transitions.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which this PBM contract record was ingested into the lakehouse silver layer (e.g., RxClaim, Argus, manual entry). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: specialty_pharmacy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialty pharmacy benefit management (high-cost biologics, specialty injectables) is within the scope of this PBM contract. True = specialty pharmacy included; False = carved out or not applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; URAC; Internal Specialty Pharmacy Policy

attributes.name: step_therapy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy protocols are included in the scope of this PBM contract. Step therapy requires members to try lower-cost drugs before coverage of higher-cost alternatives is authorized. True = step therapy applies; False = not applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; State Step Therapy Laws; URAC

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the PBM contract ends or was terminated. Null for open-ended contracts. Distinguishes between scheduled expiration and early termination when combined with contract_status. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: ERISA; CMS Part D; NAIC Model Regulation

products.name: formulary_exception
products.description: Transactional record for member or prescriber requests to cover a non-formulary drug or override a formulary restriction (tier exception, PA exception, step therapy exception). Captures request date, member ID, prescriber NPI, requested drug NDC, exception type, clinical justification, decision status (approved/denied), effective date range, and appeal rights notification. Supports CMS Part D coverage determination and exception request requirements.

attributes.name: formulary_exception_id
attributes.description: Primary key for formulary_exception

attributes.name: condition_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.condition_registry. Business justification: Formulary exceptions are clinically justified by a member's diagnosed condition in the condition registry. Proper FK replaces denormalized diagnosis_code, enables clinical justification validation aga

attributes.name: drug_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.drug_master. Business justification: A formulary exception request is for a specific drug (non-formulary or tier override). The drug_ndc and drug_name STRING columns on formulary_exception should be normalized to a FK referencing drug_ma

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific formulary against which the exception is being evaluated. A plan may maintain multiple formularies (e.g., commercial, Medicare Part D, Medicaid). Links to the formulary master in the PBM system (RxClaim/Argus).
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements 42 CFR §423.120; USP Drug Classification

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical pharmacist, pharmacy technician, or medical director who reviewed and rendered the decision on the formulary exception request. Links to the workforce/staff entity.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.578; NCQA Utilization Management Standards

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associated appeal record if the member or prescriber has filed an appeal against a denied formulary exception. Links to the appeals management entity. Null if no appeal has been filed.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.580–423.602; 42 CFR §423.580; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18

attributes.name: prior_authorization_id

attributes.name: appeal_rights_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the appeal rights notification was sent to the member and prescriber following a denial. Required for CMS Part D compliance tracking and audit purposes.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.572(b); 42 CFR §423.580; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18

attributes.name: appeal_rights_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required appeal rights notification was sent to the member and prescriber following a denial decision, as mandated by CMS Part D regulations. True = notification sent; False = notification not yet sent.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.572(b); 42 CFR §423.580; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18

attributes.name: clinical_justification
attributes.description: Free-text clinical rationale provided by the prescriber or member supporting the formulary exception request. attributes.name: cms_coverage_determination_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Coverage Determination Type
attributes.description: CMS-defined classification of the coverage determination process type for Part D reporting. Standard: routine 72-hour review; Expedited: 24-hour urgent review; Reopen: plan-initiated reconsideration; Revised: updated determination on a prior decision.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.568; §423.570; §423.572; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18

tag_set.value: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Coverage Determination Type

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the formulary exception record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: current_drug_tier
attributes.description: The formulary tier at which the requested drug is currently placed (or non_formulary if not on the formulary) at the time the exception request is submitted. attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements 42 CFR §423.120; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 6

attributes.name: days_supply_requested
attributes.description: Number of days of drug supply requested in the formulary exception, applicable for quantity limit or day supply override exceptions. Standard values are 30, 60, or 90 days.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Day Supply Requirements; NCPDP Day Supply Standards

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the final determination (approval or denial) was made on the formulary exception request. Used to calculate turnaround time and assess CMS timeliness compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.568; 42 CFR §423.572; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the exception determination was rendered. Enables exact measurement of response time against CMS 72-hour standard and 24-hour expedited decision deadlines.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.568; §423.570; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for denial of the formulary exception request (e.g., formulary alternative available, insufficient clinical documentation, drug not medically necessary). Null for approved or pending requests. Used in EOB and appeal rights notifications.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.572; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18; NCQA Standards

attributes.name: denial_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable explanation of the reason for denial of the formulary exception request. Included in the written notice of denial sent to the member and prescriber as required by CMS Part D regulations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.572; 42 CFR §423.572(b); CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date through which an approved formulary exception remains valid. After this date, the member must reapply or the standard formulary restriction resumes. Null for open-ended approvals or non-approved requests.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.566; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which an approved formulary exception is valid and the member may obtain the drug at the excepted tier or without the formulary restriction. Null for denied or pending requests.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.566; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18

attributes.name: exception_request_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable unique reference number assigned to the formulary exception request at intake. Used by members, prescribers, and pharmacies to track the status of the request. Generated by the PBM system (RxClaim/Argus) or UM system.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Coverage Determination and Exception Request Requirements 42 CFR §423.566

attributes.name: exception_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the formulary exception request. Pending: under review; Approved: exception granted; Denied: exception not granted; Withdrawn: requestor cancelled; Expired: approved exception past effective period; Appealed: denial under appeal review.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Coverage Determination and Exception Request Requirements 42 CFR §423.566; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Classification of the formulary exception request indicating the specific restriction being challenged. Values: non_formulary (drug not on formulary), tier_exception (request lower cost-sharing tier), pa_exception (override Prior Authorization requirement), step_therapy_exception (bypass step therapy protocol), quantity_limit_exception (override quantity/day supply limit), coverage_determination (standard CMS Part D coverage determination). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_formulary|tier_exception|pa_exception|step_therapy_exception|quantity_limit_exception|coverage_determination — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Part D Coverage Determinations and Exceptions 42 CFR §423.566–423.600; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18

attributes.name: formulary_alternative_ndc
attributes.business_glossary_term: Formulary Alternative Drug National Drug Code (NDC)
attributes.description: 11-digit NDC of the formulary-covered alternative drug suggested by the plan when denying a non-formulary or tier exception request. Required by CMS to be communicated to the member and prescriber in the denial notice.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.572; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18; FDA NDC Directory

tag_set.value: Formulary Alternative Drug National Drug Code (NDC)

attributes.name: is_expedited
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formulary exception request was submitted and processed under the expedited (24-hour) review pathway, as opposed to the standard (72-hour) pathway. Expedited requests require prescriber attestation that the standard timeframe would seriously jeopardize the member's life, health, or ability to regain maximum function.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.570; 42 CFR §423.570(b); CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Line of Business (LOB) under which the formulary exception is processed. Determines applicable regulatory framework, formulary rules, and exception adjudication standards (e.g., CMS Part D rules apply only to Medicare Part D LOB).
attributes.references: CMS Part D 42 CFR §423; ACA §1301; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: quantity_requested
attributes.description: The quantity of the drug (in dispensing units) for which the exception is requested, applicable for quantity limit exception requests. Expressed in the drug's standard dispensing unit (e.g., tablets, milliliters).
attributes.references: CMS Part D Quantity Limit Requirements; NCPDP Quantity Dispensed Standards

attributes.name: request_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the formulary exception request was submitted. Values: phone (member/prescriber call), fax (fax submission), portal (member or prescriber web portal), edi (electronic data interchange transaction), mail (paper/postal), prescriber_portal (dedicated prescriber e-prescribing or PBM portal).
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.566; HIPAA EDI Transaction Standards

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the formulary exception request was formally submitted by the member, prescriber, or authorized representative. This is the principal business event date used for CMS timeliness compliance tracking (72-hour standard, 24-hour expedited).

attributes.name: request_received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the formulary exception request was received and logged in the PBM or UM system. Used for exact timeliness measurement against CMS regulatory response deadlines.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.568; 42 CFR §423.570; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18

attributes.name: requested_drug_tier
attributes.description: The formulary cost-sharing tier to which the requestor is asking the drug to be assigned for this member (e.g., requesting Tier 2 generic pricing for a Tier 3 preferred brand). Applicable for tier exception requests.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Tier Structure 42 CFR §423.120; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 6

attributes.name: requestor_type
attributes.description: Identifies who initiated the formulary exception request. Member: the enrollee themselves; Prescriber: the treating physician or authorized prescriber; Authorized Representative: a legally designated representative acting on behalf of the member; Pharmacy: the dispensing pharmacy acting on behalf of the member.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.566(b); 42 CFR §423.566; CMS Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 18

attributes.name: review_level
attributes.description: Level of clinical review applied to the formulary exception request. Pharmacist: initial review by clinical pharmacist; Medical Director: escalated review by physician medical director; Peer to Peer: prescriber-to-medical-director discussion; Committee: pharmacy and therapeutics committee review.
attributes.references: CMS Part D §423.578; NCQA Utilization Management Standards; URAC Pharmacy Benefit Management Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this formulary exception record originated. Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer. Values: rxclaim, argus (PBM systems), interqual, mcg (UM systems), facets, qnxt (core admin), manual (manually entered). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rxclaim|argus|interqual|mcg|facets|qnxt|manual — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: step_therapy_drugs_tried
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of NDCs or drug names of step therapy prerequisite drugs that the member has already tried and failed, as documented in the step therapy exception request. Supports clinical review and CMS step therapy override requirements.

attributes.name: supporting_doc_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required clinical supporting documentation (e.g., prescriber letter of medical necessity, lab results, treatment history) has been received from the prescriber or member. True = documentation received; False = documentation pending or not received.

attributes.name: supporting_doc_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the required clinical supporting documentation was received from the prescriber or member. Used to calculate the effective review start date and CMS timeliness compliance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

For periodic reconciliation: captures reconciliation period, total billed, total collected, total adjustments, variance amount, variance reason, reconciliation status (open, in review, approved, closed), approver reference, and reconciliation type (monthly, quarterly, annual). Supports MLR calculation inputs, financial close processes, CMS premium reconciliation, and end-to-end premium reconciliation from individual line-level allocation through period-level summary and variance analysis. SSOT for all payment allocation and premium reconciliation in the billing domain.

products.name: adequacy_standard
products.description: Reference entity defining all network compliance standards by specialty, facility type, and geographic area — encompassing time-distance standards (e.g., 30 miles/30 minutes for PCPs), provider-to-member ratios, appointment access wait-time standards (routine, urgent, preventive, behavioral health), after-hours availability requirements, and telehealth equivalency rules. Captures regulatory source (CMS, state DOI, NCQA, URAC), standard category (time-distance, provider-ratio, appointment-access, after-hours, telehealth-equivalency), specialty category, geographic classification (urban, suburban, rural, frontier), maximum wait time in days, threshold values, and after-hours availability flag. This is the single source of truth for all network adequacy and access compliance standards — both geographic access (time-distance, ratios) and appointment access (wait times, after-hours). Used to evaluate compliance in adequacy assessments, access surveys, and CMS/state regulatory filings.
products.reference: CMS Network Adequacy Time-Distance Standards — 42 CFR 438.68

products.name: adequacy_assessment
products.description: Transactional record of a network compliance evaluation — including network adequacy assessments, access surveys, mystery shopper studies, and gap identification. Captures assessment type (adequacy, access-survey, mystery-shopper), assessment date, regulatory submission type (CMS, state DOI), specialty/facility type evaluated, provider counts, member-to-provider ratios, time-distance compliance results, wait-time measurements, survey method (member survey, secret shopper call), appointment type requested, telehealth offered flag, and overall compliance outcome. Includes detail-level gap findings as child records: specific specialty or facility type shortfalls within a geographic area, gap severity, number of providers available vs. required, remediation actions taken, and resolution status. Supports CMS network adequacy filings, NCQA HEDIS access measures (Getting Care Quickly), CAHPS survey supplementation, and targeted network development. This is the SSOT for all network compliance evaluations and their associated gap findings.

domains.name: contract
domains.description: Manages provider contracts, reimbursement agreements, capitation arrangements, fee schedules, value-based care (VBC) contracts, ACO agreements, risk-sharing models, contract terms, amendments, and contract lifecycle. Tracks contract effective dates, rate tables, and payment methodologies (fee-for-service, capitation, bundled payments). SSOT for all contractual and reimbursement terms between the health plan and providers.

products.name: party
products.description: Identifies all parties bound by a provider contract — the health plan entity, the contracting provider (individual NPI or organizational NPI), group practice, IPA, ACO, or hospital system. Tracks party role (payer, provider, delegated entity), NPI, TIN, legal entity name, signatory authority, and party effective dates. Supports multi-party and delegated contracting arrangements.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each party record in the provider contract domain. Serves as the primary key for all contractual party references across the health plan enterprise.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification; CMS Provider Enrollment Standards

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider contract this party is bound by. Links the party record to its governing contractual agreement within the contract domain.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.provider. Business justification: Party represents a provider entity in a contract; linking to its credential record enables tracking of credential status and compliance per party.

attributes.name: aco_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is an Accountable Care Organization (ACO) participating in a value-based care (VBC) arrangement. Triggers ACO-specific contract terms, shared savings calculations, and CMS reporting requirements.
attributes.references: CMS ACO Regulations 42 CFR Part 425; CMS Shared Savings Program; ACA Section 3022

attributes.name: capitation_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is eligible to receive capitation payments (Per Member Per Month - PMPM) under the contract. Drives capitation payment processing and actuarial PMPM rate application.
attributes.references: CMS Capitation Payment Standards; CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR Part 422; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: contract_party_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to this party within the contract management system (e.g., Cactus or ProviderSource provider contract number). Used for cross-system reconciliation, EDI transactions, and provider directory publication.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; HIPAA EDI Transaction Standards; Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource)

attributes.name: credentialing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party was most recently credentialed or re-credentialed by the health plan. NCQA requires re-credentialing every 36 months. Used to trigger re-credentialing workflows and network compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current credentialing status of the party as maintained in the Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource). Determines whether the party is eligible to provide services to plan members. Credentialing must be current for claims to be adjudicated as in-network.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; CMS Provider Enrollment; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: delegation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is a delegated entity authorized to perform functions on behalf of the health plan (e.g., credentialing, utilization management, claims processing). Triggers delegation oversight and audit requirements per NCQA and state DOI standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Delegation Standards; State DOI Delegation Requirements; URAC Standards

attributes.name: delegation_scope
attributes.description: Specifies the functional scope of delegation authority granted to this party. Applicable only when delegation_indicator is true. Defines which health plan functions the delegated entity is authorized to perform on behalf of the payer.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Delegation Standards; State DOI Delegation Requirements; URAC Standards

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: Trade name or DBA name under which the party operates, if different from the legal entity name. Commonly used for group practices and hospital systems that operate under a brand name distinct from their legal registration.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party's participation in the contract becomes effective. Drives claims adjudication eligibility windows, network directory publication, and provider credentialing timelines.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the contracting party as registered with state or federal authorities. Used for contract execution, credentialing, and regulatory reporting. May be an individual provider name, group practice name, IPA, ACO, or hospital system name.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162; CMS Provider Enrollment; NAIC Model Law

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party's primary state professional or business license expires. Triggers credentialing re-verification workflows and may result in contract suspension if not renewed. Critical for NCQA and URAC credentialing compliance.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation where the party holds its primary professional or business license. Used for network adequacy reporting, credentialing, and state-specific regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standards; State DOI Licensing Requirements; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Health plan line of business under which this party is contracted. Determines applicable regulatory requirements, reimbursement methodologies, and network adequacy standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|medicare_advantage|medicaid|marketplace|cobra|fehb — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR Part 422; CMS Medicaid Regulations; ACA Marketplace Rules

attributes.name: malpractice_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party maintains active professional liability (malpractice) insurance coverage as required by the contract. Failure to maintain coverage may trigger contract suspension or termination per NCQA credentialing standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; State DOI Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: malpractice_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party's professional liability (malpractice) insurance policy expires. Triggers credentialing re-verification and contract compliance monitoring workflows.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; State DOI Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: network_participation_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party is a participating (PAR) in-network provider, a non-participating (non-PAR) provider, or an out-of-network provider. Drives member cost-sharing calculations, claims adjudication rules, and EOB generation.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards; NCQA Network Standards; ACA 45 CFR Part 156

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing supplemental information about the party that does not fit structured attributes. May include contract negotiation notes, special arrangement details, or credentialing exceptions. Classified as confidential due to potential inclusion of sensitive business information.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the provider party. Type 1 NPI for individual providers; Type 2 NPI for organizational providers. Required for all HIPAA-covered transactions including 837 claims and 270/271 eligibility inquiries.
attributes.references: HIPAA NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162.406; CMS NPI Registry; AMA Provider Standards

attributes.name: npi_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the NPI is Type 1 (individual/solo practitioner) or Type 2 (organizational entity such as group practice, hospital, or IPA). Determines credentialing requirements and contract structure.
attributes.references: HIPAA NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162.406; CMS NPI Registry

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party appears on the OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE). Excluded parties are prohibited from participating in Medicare, Medicaid, and other federal healthcare programs. Checked monthly per CMS compliance requirements.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; 42 USC 1320a-7; CMS Provider Enrollment; HIPAA Compliance

tag_set.value: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Indicator

attributes.name: party_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the party within the contract. Indicates whether the party is actively bound by the contract, pending execution, suspended, terminated, or inactive. Drives eligibility verification and claims adjudication routing.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: party_type
attributes.description: Classifies the party as an individual (natural person, e.g., solo practitioner with individual NPI) or an organization (legal entity, e.g., group practice, hospital, IPA, ACO). Drives NPI type assignment and credentialing workflow.
attributes.references: HIPAA NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162.406; CMS NPI Registry

attributes.name: primary_specialty_code
attributes.description: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code representing the party's primary clinical specialty. Used for network adequacy analysis, claims routing, prior authorization rules, and provider directory classification.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; CMS Provider Enrollment; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: raf_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) scoring applies to this party's contract arrangement. Relevant for Medicare Advantage and ACA marketplace contracts where Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) risk scores drive capitation payments.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Regulations 42 CFR Part 422; CMS RAPS/EDPS; ACA Section 1343

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting requirements. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164; Enterprise Data Governance Standards; SOC 2 Audit Requirements

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change data capture, audit trail, and SCD Type 2 processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164; Enterprise Data Governance Standards; SOC 2 Audit Requirements

attributes.name: recredentialing_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the party must complete re-credentialing to maintain active network participation. Calculated as 36 months from the credentialing_date per NCQA standards. Drives automated re-credentialing workflow initiation.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Functional role of this party within the contract relationship. Identifies whether the party is the health plan (payer), a contracting provider, a delegated entity, an Independent Practice Association (IPA), an Accountable Care Organization (ACO), a hospital system, or a group practice. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: payer|provider|delegated_entity|ipa|aco|hospital_system|group_practice — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; NCQA Credentialing Standards; NAIC Model Law

attributes.name: sanction_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has an active sanction, exclusion, or adverse action recorded by OIG, SAM, or state licensing boards. A true value triggers contract suspension review and claims payment hold per CMS and HIPAA compliance requirements.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Database; SAM.gov Exclusions; CMS Provider Enrollment; HIPAA 42 CFR Part 1001

attributes.name: service_area_state
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation representing the primary state in which this party provides services under the contract. Used for network adequacy reporting, state regulatory compliance, and geographic claims routing.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards; State DOI Service Area Requirements; ACA 45 CFR Part 156

attributes.name: service_area_zip_code
attributes.description: Primary ZIP code of the party's principal service location. Used for network adequacy geo-mapping, member-to-provider distance calculations, and CMS network adequacy submissions.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards; NCQA Network Standards; ACA 45 CFR Part 156

attributes.name: signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized individual who signed or has authority to sign the contract on behalf of this party. Required for contract execution validation and legal enforceability. Typically the CEO, CMO, or designated contracting officer.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Law; State DOI Contract Requirements; ERISA

attributes.name: signatory_title
attributes.description: Official title or position of the authorized signatory (e.g., Chief Executive Officer, Medical Director, Contracting Officer). Validates the authority level of the individual executing the contract on behalf of the party.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Law; State DOI Contract Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this party record originated (e.g., Cactus, ProviderSource, Facets, QNXT). Supports data lineage tracking, reconciliation, and ETL audit in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Standards; HIPAA Data Integrity Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_party_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this party record in the originating operational system (e.g., Cactus provider ID, ProviderSource contract party key). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability from the Silver Layer back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Standards; HIPAA Data Integrity Requirements

attributes.name: state_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued professional or business license number for the contracting party. Required for credentialing verification and network participation. For individual providers, this is the state medical license; for organizations, the state business license or certificate of authority.
attributes.references: State DOI Licensing Requirements; NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party's participation in the contract ends. Null for open-ended or currently active parties. Used to determine network participation windows, claims payment eligibility, and member notification requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: Federal Tax Identification Number (EIN or SSN) used for payment processing, 1099 reporting, and IRS compliance. Critical for remittance and premium payment routing. Stored as 9-digit numeric string without hyphens.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_type
attributes.description: Specifies the payment methodology or value-based care arrangement type applicable to this party under the contract. Drives reimbursement calculation logic, risk-sharing model application, and financial reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fee_for_service|capitation|bundled_payment|shared_savings|global_risk — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Care Programs; CMS ACO Regulations 42 CFR Part 425; NAIC Model Contract Law

products.name: term
products.description: Defines the specific terms, conditions, obligations, and reimbursement policies within a provider contract. Captures term type (payment methodology, exclusivity, termination clause, audit rights, hold-harmless, indemnification, confidentiality, HIPAA BAA, reimbursement rule), term text, effective date, expiration date, and whether the term is negotiable or standard boilerplate. For reimbursement rule terms: captures policy sub-type (multiple procedure reduction, bilateral procedure, assistant surgeon, global surgery, unbundling rules, place-of-service differential), applicable CPT/HCPCS ranges, reduction percentage, and LOB applicability. Enables granular tracking of contractual obligations, compliance checkpoints, and reimbursement adjudication rules. Bridges contract terms to claims adjudication logic in Facets/QNXT.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a contract term record in the provider contract management system (Facets/QNXT or Provider Management System). Serves as the primary key for the term entity.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent provider contract to which this term belongs. Links the term to its governing contract in the Provider Network Management system.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fee schedule associated with this term when payment_methodology is fee_for_service. Links to the rate table governing allowed amounts for procedure codes under this term.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule; Provider Network Management — Cactus/ProviderSource

attributes.name: audit_rights_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years the health plan retains the right to audit provider records under this audit rights term. Typically 7 years per HIPAA and CMS requirements. Applicable when term_type is 'audit_rights'.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR 164.530(j); CMS Medicare Advantage Audit Requirements (42 CFR 422.504); ERISA 29 CFR 2520

attributes.name: auto_renew
attributes.description: Indicates whether this term automatically renews upon expiration without requiring renegotiation (True). Supports contract lifecycle management and renewal notification workflows.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; Provider Network Management — Cactus/ProviderSource

attributes.name: capitation_rate
attributes.description: The Per Member Per Month (PMPM) capitation rate defined by this term when payment_methodology is capitation. Represents the fixed monthly payment per enrolled member to the provider regardless of services rendered. Classified confidential as proprietary pricing.
attributes.references: CMS Capitation Rate Setting Guidelines; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: compliance_checkpoint_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next compliance review or audit checkpoint associated with this term. Used by the compliance team to track regulatory obligations, CMS audit readiness, and DOI examination preparation.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Compliance Program Requirements (42 CFR 422.503); State DOI Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: cpt_range_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Range End
attributes.description: The ending CPT or HCPCS procedure code of the range to which this reimbursement rule term applies. Used in conjunction with cpt_range_start to define the applicable procedure code range for adjudication.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Editorial Panel; CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Guidelines

tag_set.value: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Range End

attributes.name: cpt_range_start
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Range Start
attributes.description: The starting CPT or HCPCS procedure code of the range to which this reimbursement rule term applies. Used in conjunction with cpt_range_end to define the applicable procedure code range for adjudication.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Editorial Panel; CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Guidelines

tag_set.value: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Range Start

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract term record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record retention requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR 164.312(b); CMS Medicare Advantage Audit Requirements; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: The contractually agreed method for resolving disputes arising under this term: Arbitration, Mediation, Litigation, or Internal Review. Applicable for hold-harmless, indemnification, and audit rights terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; ERISA 29 CFR Part 2560; State DOI Dispute Resolution Requirements

attributes.name: drg_grouper_version

attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Grouper; 3M APR-DRG Grouper; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.references: CMS Provider Agreement Guidelines; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: governing_state

attributes.name: hipaa_baa_required

attributes.name: icd_version

attributes.name: incentive_amount

attributes.name: is_adjudication_rule

attributes.name: is_negotiable

attributes.references: Provider Network Management — Cactus/ProviderSource; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: is_standard_boilerplate

attributes.references: Provider Network Management — Cactus/ProviderSource; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: lob_applicability

attributes.name: mac_pricing_basis

Applicable for terms covering pharmacy benefits.
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid Drug Rebate Program; PBM Contracting Standards; NAIC Model Pharmacy Benefit Standards

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Human-readable external identifier for the term, typically formatted as a section or clause reference (e.g., 'TERM-2024-0042' or 'Section 4.2.1'). Used in contract documents and correspondence.

attributes.name: payment_methodology

Includes Fee-for-Service (FFS), Capitation, Bundled Payment, Case Rate, Per Diem, Diagnosis Related Group (DRG)-based, Reference Based Pricing (RBP), and Value-Based Care (VBC). attributes.name: pos_code
attributes.description: The CMS Place of Service (POS) code to which this term's reimbursement differential applies, when reimbursement_policy_subtype is 'pos_differential'. Two-digit code per CMS POS code set (e.g., '11' for Office, '21' for Inpatient Hospital).
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Code Set; CMS Claims Processing Manual (Pub. 100-04, Ch. 26)

attributes.name: quality_metric_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum quality performance threshold (expressed as a percentage or score) that the provider must achieve to qualify for incentive payments or avoid penalties under quality incentive terms. Linked to HEDIS or STAR measures.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Star Ratings Methodology; URAC Quality Standards

attributes.name: reduction_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage reduction applied to the allowed amount under this reimbursement rule term (e.g., 50.00 for a 50% reduction on secondary procedures under multiple procedure reduction policy). Applicable when reimbursement_policy_subtype is set. Classified confidential as it represents proprietary pricing.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Editorial Panel Guidelines; CMS Claims Processing Manual (Pub. 100-04); NCCI

attributes.name: reimbursement_policy_subtype
